sender_address.description: Native contact email address as supplied by the pinned RPC ContactObject, recorded as observed platform identity. It MUST NOT be used as a contact identity lookup key. Absent, padded or whitespace-bearing values are omitted.

timestamp_sent.description: Native message send time in unix seconds as supplied by the pinned RPC MessageObject 'timestamp' field; omitted when absent or nonpositive.

timestamp_received.description: Native message receive time in unix seconds as supplied by the pinned RPC MessageObject 'receivedTimestamp' field; omitted when absent or nonpositive (as for most outgoing messages).

chat_type.description: Validated native conversation kind observed at connection setup from BasicChat 'chatType'.

chat_name.description: Native conversation name observed at connection setup from BasicChat 'name'. maxLength counts Unicode characters; a 1024 UTF-8 byte limit is enforced at capture time. Malformed or oversized names are omitted.

chat_protected.description: Key-contact protection state observed at connection setup from BasicChat 'isEncrypted' (all contacts are key-contacts); does not imply bridge confidentiality.

sender_override.description: Untrusted per-message display claim; does not replace contact identity. maxLength counts Unicode characters; ingress and delivery validators separately enforce a 1024 UTF-8 byte limit and reject display-altering format controls other than Unicode joiners.

public_facts.description: Explicitly opted-in projection of bounded source facts for core's transport-neutral bridge context; the copy source for 'chatmail' public facts. Never raw native data.
